context.description: Write the fault-folder test that runs the real /task command on each folder

evidence.trustReason: Layer-3 review of packages/opencode/test/task/fault-folders.test.ts (ce1c1c34f1) and the helper move test/task/lib/command.ts (9aaf26ca6f, a pure move). Happy Path VF9-VF13: one git-instance case per folder runs the real TaskCommand.run with fake Ops on a committed copy; expect(rule ids).toEqual(planted) pins R1,R3,R4 / R7 / R7 / R6 / R3 exactly and in loader order, and expect(replies).toEqual([EXPERIENCE header 'Refused <spec>: N failure(s). No work started.' + the loader lines + the hint]) proves one line per planted rule and no other; the line texts are pinned literally in blend.test.ts. Boundary VF14: the T1.2 subtree reply equals the literal header, the literal R12 line naming T1.2 and T1.1 and the hint; status.json matches state refused, spec, path, reason; no job; the whole spec gets the start line and exactly one job start. Error Propagation: status.json run toMatchObject state refused, reason = lines joined by newline, for every folder. Security: every ops.prompt is recorded and exactly one (the refusal) occurs, jobs.starts is empty and harness.live is none, so no model request or lease; residual note: the fake Ops does not assert noReply:true on the reply (a constant in command.ts reply). Concurrency N/A. Runs: fault-folders 7 pass 0 fail (30 expects, exit 0, twice); core-command 44 pass 0 fail (115 expects, exit 0).
